model_status: public-data house scenario model; formal H1 unit economics and cash flow remain undisclosed
growth_driver: lithium sales volume x realised-revenue proxy x gross margin, supplemented by civil-explosives product, blasting-service and transport gross profit

historical_operating_base_2025a.evidence_type: L1 audited issuer disclosure; transport margin is a derived residual

formal_h1_status.model_rule: H1 parent NP is an anchor only; H2 is independently scenario-modelled and no quarter is annualised.

base_business_revenue: civil-explosives product, blasting service and transport
value_amount_or_proxy: 2025 lithium revenue and tonnes sold; 2026-2027 realised-revenue proxy is an explicit House assumption, not spot lithium price or company ASP
supply_demand_state: industry price beta confirmed; company unit economics and H2 customer conversion not disclosed
capacity_or_utilization: near 130kt lithium design capacity disclosed; no production-capacity utilisation used as revenue input
certification_or_customer_qualification: long-term customer relationships confirmed; customer allocation and orders not disclosed

valuation_credit.lithium: conditional earnings credit; no self-supply, inventory or hedging premium
valuation_credit.civil_explosives: low-to-medium earnings credit based on audited historical revenue/gross margin only
valuation_credit.resources: zero incremental valuation credit pending actual delivery and cost disclosure

scenario_2026e.validation_evidence: H1 OCF and working capital, H2 realised price/cost, actual lithium sales volume
scenario_2026e.downgrade_trigger: H2 parent NP below CNY400m or H1 cash conversion deteriorates

scenario_2026e.validation_evidence: H1 segment gross margin/actual ASP and cost, positive operating cash flow, receivables and inventory containment
scenario_2026e.downgrade_trigger: H1 unit-economics disclosure cannot support H2 CNY810m parent NP or cash conversion remains weak

scenario_2026e.validation_evidence: sustained H2 volume/price, disclosed cost advantage and positive cash conversion
scenario_2026e.downgrade_trigger: any failure of H2 quantity, realised-price, cost or cash bridge

evidence_gap: no H1 segment revenue, volume, realised ASP, unit cost or cash flow
no actual resource self-supply ratio or cash cost
no H1 civil-explosives order, margin or collection disclosure
current_price_implied_growth: CNY17.75 equals 13.64x/10.18x/8.28x the House bear/base/bull 2026E EPS; it does not validate the House model.
sensitivity_key: H2 lithium realised margin and volume, followed by operating cash conversion
not_applicable_or_zero_credit: industry spot price as company ASP
broker shipment/cost assumptions as House inputs
